mapper.select: IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmp_rpt_count') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmp_rpt_count CREATE TABLE #tmp_rpt_count ( year varchar(10), month varchar(10), customer_id varchar(100), Gauge varchar(100), order_qty int, producing_company varchar(10) ) INSERT INTO #tmp_rpt_count EXEC rpt_group_reporting_customer_sabrina '${yMFrom}', '${yMTo}' SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #tmp_rpt_count

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmp_rpt') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmp_rpt CREATE TABLE #tmp_rpt ( year varchar(10), month varchar(10), customer_id varchar(100), Gauge varchar(100), order_qty int, producing_company varchar(10) ) INSERT INTO #tmp_rpt EXEC rpt_group_reporting_customer_sabrina '${yMFrom}', '${yMTo}' SELECT * FROM #tmp_rpt ORDER BY year, month OFFSET ${offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT ${pageSize} ROWS ONLY

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmp_rpt_sum') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmp_rpt_sum CREATE TABLE #tmp_rpt_sum ( year varchar(10), month varchar(10), customer_id varchar(100), Gauge varchar(100), order_qty int, producing_company varchar(10) ) INSERT INTO #tmp_rpt_sum EXEC rpt_group_reporting_customer_sabrina '${yMFrom}', '${yMTo}' SELECT year, SUM(order_qty) AS totalQty FROM #tmp_rpt_sum GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
